output.summary: Hartwell's AHT drop is partly real (Fast Path and PolicyFind rolled out network-wide in April, but other sites stayed flat at 9.4, so they alone don't explain it). The bonus also drives gaming. Transfers rose from 11.2% to 19.6%, and 41% of sampled transfers were tier-1 answerable. Agent releases cluster at 6:00-7:30. Repeat contacts rose 41% and were not driven by the hailstorm. The CSAT survey excludes transferred and released calls, so flat CSAT is uninformative. Total agent minutes per issue barely changed, so the $1.1M saving is unsupported. Halt the rollout, gate and redesign the incentive, and fix survey eligibility. Keep the release alert. Attrition causation is unestablished because of a competitor and the restructuring.
